shortDescription: A short description of the universe
wearFactorTooltip:
Whether and how quickly equipment wears out.
It takes x uses of the item for it to wear out once, where x is the wear rate.
In the case of a weapon, this would mean it would lose one damage.
A wear factor of zero or smaller means it is deactivated.
wearFactorDescription:
An equipment wears out after {{wearFactor}} uses.
A weapon will loose one damage after {{wearFactor}} uses and a piece of armor will loose one armor after {{wearFactor}} uses.
baseCurrencyShortFormTooltip: A well-known example is € for the euro.
baseCurrencyDescription: The smallest monetary unit that can be traded is {{currency}}. It is usually abbreviated to '{{shortForm}}' in writing.
calculationCurrencyDescription: The next monetary unit is {{currency}} ({{shortForm}}). {{factor}} {{prevCurrency}} equals one {{currency}}.
noUniverses: You don't have access to any universe.
noUniversesDetails: Talk to a universe owner or to an admin to get the rights to create universes.
noUniverseSelectedDetails: Please select a universe. If you can't select a universe, you must be invited to a universe.
confirmPermissionDeletionTitle: Do you want to remove the access rights of the user?
confirmDeletionTitle: Do you want to delete the universe?
currencyExplanation: A currency is made up of several coins or similar. Each coin can be converted into one of the others. The conversion starts with the smallest coin and the conversion factor is always calculated from the previous coin.
startingExplanation: You can add various objects to your universe here. These are objects that are required in most universes. Everything that is imported here can be deleted or edited later. The language must be defined beforehand so that the data can be imported into the universe in the correct language.
defaultItemTypesExplanation: This import contains all item types required for common equipment. This includes the correct restrictions for the types and their dependency on each other. It is recommended to use this import.
defaultMaterialsExplanation: This import contains a few materials, their associated items, item types and recipes.
minPrimaryAttributeValue: Minimal value of a Primary Attribute
maxPrimaryAttributeValue: Maximum value of a Primary Attribute
maxPrimaryAttributeSum: Maximal amount of primary attribute points.
primaryAttributeDistributionExplanation: On average, a primary attribute will have {{average}} points. Maximum {{max}} Attributes can have the maximum value. The average chance of a successful talent roll without talent points is {{averageChance}}%. The highest chance is {{highestChance}}% and the lowest is {{lowestChance}}%.
numberOfHandheld: Number of pieces of equipment held in the hand
jewelleryDefinitionsExplanation: Define which jewellery a player or enemy can wear.
jewelleryImportExplanation: Importing the recommended definitions only works if the equipment item types have been imported.
importMissingRequirements: The required item types were not imported beforehand or they were imported with a different language.
getSecondaryAttributeInfos: Calculate the intervals of the secondary attributes
shieldUsingDice: Whether shields should additional using a dice while blocking.
usingProtection: Whether armor/shields are using protection. Protection gets reduced with each hit taken. If protection hits 0, the armor doesn't provide any armor any longer. It resets after each fight.
